title: Aurora Kiss | HAIR COLOUR [165ml]
description: Show off your blue hues with Aurora Kiss, a deep sapphire blue hair dye with subtle teal undertones that create a mesmerising, ocean-inspired dimension. Why You’ll Love It: • DIY Formula – Easy at-home coloring • Ultra-Hydrating & Deep Conditioning – Keeps hair soft and healthy • Long-Lasting & Fade-Resistant – Enjoy bold, vibrant colour  • Works on Different Base Colors – Best on pre-lightened hair (level 8+), but adds a rich blue tint to darker hair • No Harsh Chemicals – Free from peroxide, ammonia, and PPD for gentle coloring Best Results: Before applying, always perform a strand test to ensure the desired shade and compatibility with your hair. For the brightest blue, apply Aurora Kiss on platinum or light blonde hair. On darker hair, expect a deep navy-toned hue. 100% Vegan & Cruelty-Free – Because your hair deserves the best! Features: Semi-Permanent DIY Formula Vegan & Cruelty Free Hydrating & Deep Conditioning No Harsh Chemicals Benefits: ✔ DIY Friendly – Easy, mess-free application at home ✔ Hydrating & Deep Conditioning – Nourishes and softens hair ✔ Long-Lasting Semi-Permanent Colour – Vibrant results that fade beautifully  ✔ No Harsh Chemicals – Free from peroxide, ammonia, and PPD ✔ 100% Vegan & Cruelty-Free – Kind to hair, kind to animals ✔ Recyclable Tube & Carton – Eco-friendly packaging for a more sustainable choice How To Use: Step 1 Shampoo your hair and dry it completely. Do not use conditioner or any additional hair treatments. Apply petroleum jelly around your hairline to prevent staining and wear protective gloves. Perform a strand test with your colour(s) to ensure you'll love the result on your current base. If your strand test results are not to your liking, you may need to change your colour plan or lighten your base further before proceeding.  Step 2 Pour all chosen hair colors into Arctic Fox bowls . For best results, mix your color in a bowl first to evenly distribute the pigment, even if you're using a single shade! Never apply straight from the bottle! Section your hair based on the desired look. For full coverage, work with small sections. If you’re creating money pieces, section out the front strands. For a split dye effect, part your hair down the middle. Step 3 Apply the color evenly in small sections using the Arctic Fox brush. Leave it in for at least 30 minutes. For the best results, cover your hair with a plastic cap and use heat or blow dry for up to 15 minutes. Step 4 Rinse your hair in cold water, making sure to keep the colour away from your face.  Step 5 Style as desired, pose for a picture, and share your new look with us! ARCTIC FOX

title: Lagoon Blue | HAIR COLOUR
description: Meet me in the blue lagoon and get your mermaid vibes to 100 with this vibrant blue hair color! Punky Colour is the original semi-permanent conditioning hair color. Get outrageous color on bleached or chemically-treated hair. Create a brilliant highlight effect on darker hair. VIBRANT COLOR: Punky Semi-Permanent Conditioning Hair Colour Creme comes with color-enhancing Vegan Keratin complex for brighter, better color that lasts longer! NO BLEACH? NO PROBLEM: No peroxide required: create a brilliant highlight effect on darker hair. LONGER LASTING: A single application of this foresty green hair dye can last over 25 washes. This means you can color less often and still rock your style! CONDITIONER: Punky Colour semi-permanent hair dye conditions as it transforms. It leaves hair silky soft and healthy-looking. SUPER EASY TO USE: Simply apply directly to clean hair using gloves or tinting brush and leave on for 15 to 30 mins. Rinse hair and dispose of remaining mixture. SAFE: Punky Hair Colours are free of PPD's, paraben, ammonia and GMO's. It is vegan and cruelty free. Made in the USA. Size:  100ml Vegan Paraben-free DIRECTIONS Shampoo hair and dry. Use petroleum jelly or baby oil around hairline and on ears. Use rubber gloves and apply color evenly from hair roots to ends with a tinting brush. Comb through. Leave on approximately 15-30 minutes and then rinse out. Dispose of remaining mixture. Wash hands after application. Color will fade out with each shampoo and may last for 5-40 washes. Color may last longer depending upon type, condition, and porosity of hair. For best results, apply to dry, bleached hair first and do not condition. CAUTION: PLEASE READ Do not use in the eye area. To do so may cause blindness. Avoid contact with skin or clothing as staining will result. Keep out of reach of children. This product contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation on certain individuals and a preliminary test should first be made. To test : use soap, water or alcohol to clean a small area of skin behind ear or on inner surface of forearm. Apply small quantity of hair color to area and allow it to dry. If no irritation or inflammation is apparent, it may be assumed that no hypersensitivity to the dye exists. Do not continue to use in case of irritation. The test should be carried out before each application. First Aid : Eyes - flush with water immediately and continuously for 15 minutes, remove contact lenses if used, and consult medical personnel. Skin - rinse with water. Ingestion - consult medical personnel. Do Punky Colour, NRage, and RAW products stain?  Punky/NRage/RAW products may stain the skin and stain fabric such as clothing, towels, bedding materials, furniture tiles, grout and countertops. It will stain anything that is porous. Cover the area where you are applying and removing (Punky/RAW/NRage) with plastic bags, plastic wrap, foil, newspapers or any other materials you can discard to make sure you don’t get any unwanted staining. Rinse hair directly under a faucet and away from your face, neck or body. DO NOT rinse your hair in the shower as the color is likely to splatter and stain your shower and/or tub. Bathroom surfaces are porous so don’t take any chances. To help lessen any staining, peroxide-based cleansers can be used along with bleach or bleach-based cleaning sprays. You can also try equal parts of baking soda and liquid dish soap, mixed into a paste, and applied to the stained areas. Toothpaste applied to a cloth and rubbed in circular motions with a little bit of warm water may also help remove staining. PUNKY COLOUR

title: Mythic Plants | BOOK
description: In a beautiful, fully illustrated package, this modern, witty take on familiar Greek myths with a focus on the wild and wonderful role plants have played in the stories over centuries is S ong of Achilles  meets  The Secret Life of Trees. See the ever-popular Greek myths anew by focusing on the fascinating roles plants play in the stories. When Prometheus stole fire from the Olympian gods and gave it to mankind, he hid it in a stalk of giant fennel. Ancient Greeks waiting to question the oracles were given cannabis as part of their cleansing rituals. A quince fruit started the Trojan war. The goddess Demeter was so distraught when Hades kidnapped her daughter that she caused winter to blanket the earth, killing all plants. In Greek mythology, plants were used for tools, intoxication, warfare, food, medicine, magic, and rituals. Achilles used yarrow (now named after him as Achillea ) to stanch the flow of blood from his soldiers' wounds. (It still works.) Wine was long used by the gods, but there is evidence that other plants -- such as oleander, mandrake, and ivy-- were added to wine to create the frenzy for which Dionysus's followers were well known. Some of those plants were real and still exist today; some of them are mythological, with powers we can only imagine. This book will focus on how the ancient Greeks used plants in their lives and loves and conquests - focusing particularly on ones we can cultivate today. Includes tips throughout for bringing these ancient plants into your garden.

title: Roxy Beet | HAIR COLOUR
description: Fall in love with Roxy Beet, a mesmerising deep magenta with a hint of purple. Inspired by the deep hue of beetroot, this captivating purple hue exudes a velvety, jewel-like brilliance. Roxy Beet glows with vitality and a hint of surprise, making it a true statement shade for those who want to wear bold colours with confidence and boldness. Roxy Beet works great on different shades. On platinum blonde hair it takes on a brighter cool pink tone, and on darker hair it turns a darker purple. Roxy Beet fades beautifully to a cool fuchsia. ALL HERMAN HAIR COLOURS ARE: Conditioner-based direct dyes Vegan & cruelty-free Without harsh chemicals like ammonia or hydrogen peroxide Mixable and DIY-friendly PREPARATION: Reduce heat styling the week before bleaching. Wash your hair with a deep-cleansing shampoo before coloring and avoid conditioners or other hair care products. This will help the colour adhere better and give a more even color result, resulting in a longer-lasting colour. For best results, bleach your hair to at least level 8-9. If your hair is too yellow after bleaching, you can also use a No Yellow Shampoo or No Yellow Mask to neutralise the yellow to white before colouring. Apply and leave on for 1-3 minutes. This is important for purple tones so that the yellowness does not turn the colour brown. HOW TO USE: Apply a thick layer of Roxy Beet hair colour to towel-dried, unconditioned hair and leave on for 60-90 minutes. For longer-lasting results, leave the colour on for 2+ hours or even overnight. Herman's hair colours are conditioner-based, so they nourish your hair like an intensive treatment during colouring. Rinse with cool or lukewarm water and enjoy your vibrant hair colour. Their direct colour lasts from a few weeks to several months, depending on the shade chosen, the underlying tone and condition of the hair, as well as the exposure time of the colour and hair care routine. HERMANS

title: Toxicity | HAIR COLOUR
description: Colour: Rich Brown based Orange Features: - Creamy   Vegan & Cruelty Free   Formula 5 oz tube - Botanically Infused with Natural Sunflower Extract - Ammonia Free, Formaldehyde Free, Peroxide Free, PPD Free - Ultra creamy formula that deeply conditions while depositing colour What does it do? This semi-permanent hair dye line combines salon-grade pigments with a nontoxic, conditioning formula that deposits ultra vibrant colour. Semi-permanent hair dyes do not damage the hair, in fact they’re super conditioning! GDY’s formula combines a high-quality cream base, like a hair mask with essential oil benefits. The colour is deposited on top of the hair shaft and acts like a stain that will fade out over time each time you wash your hair. Colour can last anywhere from 4-6 weeks. What does it smell like? Fragranced with Bergamot essential oil, this semi-permanent dye has a light citrus scent that is mood lifting. Is this for my hair? These semi-permanent dyes will show the truest colour on pre-lightened hair, levels 8-10. We recommend using a Lightening Kit to get the perfect base shade for your colour. What to know? Semi-perm is a thick, conditioning formula, no need to mix with a conditioner. Colour payoff will vary based how much hair is lightened as well as on the porosity of the hair and underlying hair chemistry. We recommend a hair strand test to determine colour payoff. Safe on: All hair textures, pre lightened, chemically treated, keratin treated, and colour treated hair. GOOD DYE YOUNG

title: Serpent | DRESS, X-SMALL
description: Add a touch of venom to your wardrobe with The Serpent Dress. This mid-length, chiffon dress features a black base, brought to life with a print of white snakes emerging from blue and teal flowers. title: Diet Cola | HAIR COLOUR [165ml]
description: Pop open a fresh twist on classic brown with Diet Cola — a smooth, medium brown shade that’s effortlessly cool and refreshingly bold. Perfect for adding that subtle edge while keeping your look chill and naturally vibrant. Sip on this color for hair that’s all about flavor without the fuss. How To Use: Step 1 Shampoo your hair and dry it completely. Do not use conditioner or any additional hair treatments. Apply petroleum jelly around your hairline to prevent staining and wear protective gloves. Perform a strand test with your color(s) to ensure you'll love the result on your current base. If your strand test results are not to your liking, you may need to change your color plan or lighten your base further before proceeding.  Step 2 Pour all chosen hair colors into Arctic Fox bowls. For best results, mix your color in a bowl first to evenly distribute the pigment, even if you're using a single shade! Never apply straight from the bottle! Section your hair based on the desired look. For full coverage, work with small sections. If you’re creating money pieces, section out the front strands. For a split dye effect, part your hair down the middle.  Step 3 Apply the color evenly in small sections using the Arctic Fox brush. Leave it in for at least 30 minutes. For the best results, cover your hair with a plastic cap and use heat or blow dry for up to 15 minutes.  Step 4 Rinse your hair in cold water, making sure to keep the color away from your face.  Step 5 Style as desired, pose for a picture, and share your new look with us! title: Lost Book of Spells | BOOK
description: Discover a grimoire of over 150 spells from leading witch Fiona Horne Lost for many years, this collection draws together over 30 years of spells old and new created by Fiona Horne for everything from traditional topics such as love and relationships, self-care and wellbeing, and money and work, to up-to-the-minute issues such as social media challenges, environmental concerns and mental health in our busy modern world. Fiona Horne guides you through how to spellcast as well as different kinds of natural magick such as working with the energy of the moon and sun, and shares the secret of crafting a magickal life: stop asking for things just for you and start helping others instead. A treasure trove of magickal advice and know-how, this spell book will show you how to charm away a cold or flu, how to make your in-laws to like you, spells to find new love or add spice to your relationship, magick yourself into a new job and much more. Whether you're an experienced practitioner or just starting on your magickal life, this book is for you. Pages: 240

title: Coco Choco | HAIR COLOUR
description: Coco Choco is an indulgent deep chocolate brown semi-permanent direct hair colour. Coco Choco works beautifully on different level bases. On a platinum blonde hair it will look brighter, and on darker level bases it will lean into deeper chocolate brown. On completely platinum blonde hair, Coco reveals a hint of beautiful reddish-brown tones. Coco Choco fades gracefully into lighter brown, depending on the hair type and maintenance. ALL OF HERMAN'S HAIR COLORS ARE: Semi-permanent Vegan & cruelty-free Ultra-creamy conditioner based Without harsh chemicals, such as ammonia or hydrogen peroxide Mixable & DIY-friendly PREPARING: Reduce heating tools in the week before bleaching. Wash your hair with deep cleansing shampoo before colouring and avoid conditioner or any other hair care products. This will promote better colour adherence and seamless blending with your natural hair, resulting in longer-lasting vibrancy. For best results, bleach your hair to level 8-9 blonde with a Bleach Kit. Coco Choco will look amazing on darker bases too (level 6-7), but it will appear more dark and deep compared to blonde or platinum bases. You can also use Coco Choco to maintain box dyed colour and shift the tone into chocolatey dream. If your hair is too yellow after bleaching, use a   No Yellow Shampoo   or   No Yellow Mask   to neutralise the yellow into white. Apply and leave it in for 1-3 minutes. That is important for the results so that the yellowness won't turn the colour too warm. USING: Apply a thick layer of Coco Choco hair dye on dry (for maximum colour intensity) or towel-dry (for more sheer results), unconditioned hair and leave it in for 60 - 90 minutes. For longer lasting results leave the colour for 2+ hours or even overnight. Herman's hair colours are conditioner-based, so they nourish your hair like a deep conditioner while you colour. Rinse with cool or lukewarm water and enjoy your intense brown hair colour, that will last from a few weeks to several months, depending on the chosen shade, base and condition of the hair, duration of the colour and your hair care routine. MAINTAINING: Allow at least 24 hours before your first shampoo Wash your hair with cool or lukewarm water to minimize the fading process. Reduce hair washing days to extend color lasting. Use a   Sulfate-Free Shampoo   for washing. You can store the leftover colour for later use or mix it with your conditioner for a regular touch-up. SIZE:   115ml 100% Vegan & Cruelty-Free! Please Note:   This Product contains Sunflower Seeds! HERMAN'S PROFESSIONAL

title: Black Spring | PALETTE
description: A study in contrast. A moment of transformation. Black Spring captures the delicate tension between winter's lingering darkness and spring's first breath of life. This 15-pan eyeshadow palette tells a story of rebirth, where shadow meets bloom and frost gives way to colour. Designed with a split colour story, the palette balances deep, moody mattes and muted blues against fresh, luminous pastels and shifting multichromes. The result is a versatile edit that moves effortlessly from smoky winter depth to radiant spring softness and everything in between. Of course with Lethal's highest pigmentation shades. The split artwork, illustrated by artist @Catyhighton by hand, mirrors this duality, while the intricate mirror design of thorns and blossoms encapsulates both resilience and renewal. Inside, two marbled "special shades" and a signature matte black stamped with Lethal's silver logo offer limitless creative mixing possibilities, allowing you to customise texture, tone, and dimension! Application Tips: Mattes - Give them a quick swatch to familiarise yourself with the pigmentation. Lethal's highly pigmented shadows don't have to be swirled. Dipping your brush gently will pick up plenty of pigment. Use a blending or shader brush for best results. Metallics - Apply with a dense brush or your finger. Lethal's metallic shadows perform great when used dry, but spraying your brush with setting spray can further enhance the shine. Avoid getting moisture into your eyeshadow pan. Weight: 15 g - 24 months shelf life LETHAL COSMETICS

title: Chain Reaction | PRESS ON NAILS
description: Chain Reaction Nailz are off-white press on nails with chrome and cat-eye detailing. These deadly false nails in a short stiletto shape are all you need to complete any outfit. Includes: - 24 nails - a full range of sizes - Nail glue and a nail file How To Apply Press On Nails: 1.   Remove any and all polish. Press-ons stick best to clean nails. 2.   Gently buff your natural nails with a nail file. The goal is to rough up the surface to give the glue more to hold onto. 3.   Put 1-2 drops of glue (included) on your natural nail. 4.   Press the false nail on your natural nail and hold for at least 10 seconds. 5.   Enjoy your mani for up to two weeks! This method can also be used to have the base of the Nailz match your nail beds- just file until it's a perfect match Ingredients: Glue: Mowilith Dm21, Water, Isopropyl Alcohol, Vinyl Acetate. title: Frosé | HAIR COLOUR [165ML]
description: Turn heads with Frosé, a dreamy pastel pink hair dye with a soft, romantic touch. How To Use: Step 1 Shampoo your hair and dry it completely. Do not use conditioner or any additional hair treatments. Apply petroleum jelly around your hairline to prevent staining and wear protective gloves. Perform a strand test with your color(s) to ensure you'll love the result on your current base. If your strand test results are not to your liking, you may need to change your color plan or lighten your base further before proceeding.  Step 2 Pour all chosen hair colors into Arctic Fox bowls. For best results, mix your color in a bowl first to evenly distribute the pigment, even if you're using a single shade! Never apply straight from the bottle! Section your hair based on the desired look. For full coverage, work with small sections. If you’re creating money pieces, section out the front strands. For a split dye effect, part your hair down the middle.  Step 3 Apply the color evenly in small sections using the Arctic Fox brush. Leave it in for at least 30 minutes. For the best results, cover your hair with a plastic cap and use heat or blow dry for up to 15 minutes.  Step 4 Rinse your hair in cold water, making sure to keep the color away from your face.  Step 5 Style as desired, pose for a picture, and share your new look with us! Benefits: ✔ DIY Friendly – Easy, mess-free application at home  ✔ Hydrating & Deep Conditioning – Nourishes and softens hair  ✔ Long-Lasting Semi-Permanent Color – Vibrant results that fade beautifully  ✔ No Harsh Chemicals – Free from peroxide, ammonia, and PPD  ✔ 100% Vegan & Cruelty-Free – Kind to hair, kind to animals ARCTIC FOX
